statement: Independent touch windows correlate left/right stick touch to bits 24/20, grip touch to 29/28, and pad touch to 25/21. Some windows contain extra contacts and grip windows contain incidental left-pad contact; these are preserved, not treated as clean negatives. Pad coordinate samples reach +/-32766; source-interpreted unsigned pressure fields peak at left 946/1236/31844 for touch/light/firmer and right 2073/4193/15337. Firmer windows also set consumer-labelled click bits 26/22. They do not establish mechanical switches, calibrated force, universal thresholds or the entire representable range.

applicability.revision: Owner-authorized retail direct-wired 28de:1302; physical revision not independently re-read
applicability.firmware: bcdDevice 0404 device-version marker; firmware attributes not re-read in each input-only reduction
applicability.scope: D9 bare metal, labelled physical sessions and known consumer operations only. No virtual Steam acceptance, universal firmware behavior, calibrated force or wireless result.
